title: Our School Trip
description: A short story about a class trip to the zoo.
instructions: Read the text about a school trip, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Last Friday, my class went on a trip to the zoo. We went there by bus. Our teacher, Miss Green, came with us. The weather was sunny and warm.
First, we saw the lions. They were sleeping under a big tree. Then we visited the monkeys. They were very funny and they jumped from tree to tree.
At twelve o'clock, we had lunch on the grass. After lunch, we gave food to the goats. My favourite animal was the elephant because it was huge. We were tired but happy on the bus home.
Before we went home, we visited the zoo shop. I bought a small toy elephant for my little sister. It cost three dollars. My friend Sara bought a pen with a monkey on it.
On the bus, we sang songs. Miss Green asked, 'What did you learn today?' Tom said, 'Elephants drink a lot of water.' Sara said, 'Monkeys eat bananas and leaves.' Miss Green smiled.
We got back to school at four o'clock. My mum was at the school gate. I told her about the lions, the monkeys and the goats. At home, I gave the toy elephant to my sister. She was very happy.
The next day, we drew pictures of our favourite animals in class. I drew the big elephant. Miss Green put all the pictures on the classroom wall. Now our classroom looks like a zoo!
